intraday.structure: 1D last two confirmed fractal highs/lows (2 left, 2 right)
intraday.zones: 4H confirmed fractal wick-to-body zone, refined to extreme 1H candle
intraday.confirmation: 15m directional rejection or body-engulfing candle at first retest
intraday.entry: limit at proximal/entry line until UTC day end
intraday.stop: beyond distal/exit line by 0.10 x prior completed 1H ATR(14)
intraday.target: 2R if before next opposing zone; else 1.5R; otherwise skip

scalp.structure: 4H last two confirmed fractal highs/lows (2 left, 2 right)
scalp.zones: 1H confirmed fractal wick-to-body zone, refined to extreme 15m candle
scalp.confirmation: 5m 9/20 EMA cross; both slopes agree; daily UTC VWAP agrees; cross within 30m of first zone retest
scalp.stop: beyond 15m-refined distal line by 0.10 x prior completed 15m ATR(14)
scalp.target: 2R if before next opposing zone; else 1.5R; otherwise skip
scalp.max_hold: 6 hours or UTC day end, whichever comes first

conservative_rules: No lookahead: pivots become available only after two right-side candles close
A zone is consumed after its first retest/confirmation window
If stop and target touch within the same candle, stop is counted first
Only one position per symbol per strategy; global 3% simultaneous risk cap
Time exits are marked to market and included in net success/failure rates
